limiter_release_fix.cause: Float32 exponential gain recovery can stop below the 0.9999 unity threshold at high sample rates, retaining attenuation and LIM after clipping.
limiter_release_fix.fix: Finish stalled recovery only when the instantaneous target is unity; never clear limiting during steady overload.
limiter_release_fix.host_regression: Original implementation failed at 88200 Hz. Fixed implementation reaches exact unity and clears the meter flag at all six rates; immediate linked attack, steady overload, 50 ms release and reset pass.

led_disconnect_fix.reported_symptom: Both LEDs sometimes freeze after disconnecting the web controller while audio continues.
led_disconnect_fix.cause: LED updates shared the service loop with HID IN completion. Closing the host HID handle can leave that transfer pending indefinitely, preventing LED refresh while the independent audio loop continues.
led_disconnect_fix.fix: Independent 1 ms LED timer task; preserve the pending HID transfer and its completion ordering. Clear both LEDs when the stream is idle.
led_disconnect_fix.host_regression: Actual LED task refreshes changing peaks and completes coalesced activity pulses while HID remains pending with no spectrum self-wake; timer waits do not spin. Idle clears stale blue peaks and activity across timer wrap.

fixed.impact: Matching entity high bytes could route class requests for the wrong recipient, interface or channel into audio controls.

open_findings.issue: Delayed DMA completion polling may violate buffer ownership
open_findings.status: Code-review risk; not reproduced or fixed in this patch
open_findings.evidence: I2s::service checks latched completion bits before returning active tokens, without gating re-trigger or checking current busy state. The partner channel chains back to that channel. The legacy C path used an interrupt; Rust polls after synchronous DSP.
open_findings.required_followup: Model chained-DMA retrigger/read-pointer behavior and deliberately delay servicing in a test build; establish a safe ownership gate before changing or reclaiming active buffers. Existing abstract queue tests do not cover this peripheral timing.
